title: LOCATRIA Empirical Tool Evaluation Master Observation Summary

tests.observation: Grounded 100% of facts in provided clinic sources with paragraph citation chips; accurately recognized that shockwave therapy was not offered without hallucinating speculative claims.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for local businesses requiring zero-hallucination factual synthesis from disorganized clinic PDFs and notes, though requires manual file uploading.
tests.failure_modes: Cannot crawl live websites independently; requires manual text/PDF upload.
tests.human_oversight_required: Review source files for completeness before ingestion.

tests.observation: Generated a 3-tier radial hierarchy of 38 live Google People-Also-Ask questions specific to Austin running injury intent.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for discovering actual patient inquiry trees and local regulatory questions (e.g. Texas direct access rules).
tests.failure_modes: Provides no search volume or keyword difficulty metrics.
tests.human_oversight_required: Filter out generic non-local questions and duplicate intent branches.

tests.observation: Extracted heading structures from top 20 Austin SERP competitors, revealing coverage gaps in trail-specific gait analysis and return-to-running timelines.
tests.interpretation: Partial fit for competitive content gap analysis, but automated outline builder risks homogenizing content if unedited.
tests.failure_modes: Heavily pushes keyword density optimization that risks unnatural stuffing.
tests.human_oversight_required: Prune generic competitor subheadings and resist mechanical keyword packing.

tests.observation: Constructed an 8-section content brief with search intent taxonomy, target word counts, and checklist questions.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for establishing editorial hand-offs between local business owners and external content creators.
tests.failure_modes: Pulls national clinical guidance that can obscure local regulatory context if not manually edited.
tests.human_oversight_required: Verify brief constraints and add local clinic practice boundaries.

tests.observation: Flagged Grade 15 medical jargon and passive voice, assisting reduction to Grade 8 accessible prose in under 2 minutes.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for local healthcare businesses needing to calibrate tone for lay readers.
tests.failure_modes: Solely analyzes readability metrics; zero awareness of medical accuracy or style guides.
tests.human_oversight_required: Ensure simplification does not compromise clinical nuances or safety.

tests.observation: Drafted an 835-word educational guide strictly adhering to brief headings and negative constraints (zero hallucination of shockwave therapy).
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for context-bound long-form local drafting when bounded by verified facts.
tests.failure_modes: Can slip into mild generic praise if prompt constraints are relaxed.
tests.human_oversight_required: Line-by-line verification of clinic location, credentials, and constraints.

tests.observation: Transformed canonical clinical draft into 3 syntactically valid formats (GBP post, FAQPage JSON-LD, patient newsletter) with 100% factual fidelity.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for multi-format content distribution across local marketing channels.
tests.failure_modes: May introduce excessive promotional enthusiasm if tone is unconstrained.
tests.human_oversight_required: Test schema syntax against validators and check character count limits.

tests.observation: Enforced custom dictionary and brand style rules, flagging non-compliant abbreviations ('Apex Chiro') and phone formats.
tests.interpretation: Partial fit for local entity consistency; effective for custom-coded naming rules, but blind to unconfigured factual discrepancies.
tests.failure_modes: Cannot verify factual claims without pre-programmed organizational rules.
tests.human_oversight_required: Pre-configure and periodically update style guide terms.

tests.observation: Detected a high-risk insurance discrepancy introduced between canonical source and derivative draft in visual side-by-side split view.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for cross-asset editorial verification before publishing multi-channel content.
tests.failure_modes: Manual copy-paste required; does not offer automated continuous multi-channel diffing.
tests.human_oversight_required: Human editor must interpret whether textual diff represents intentional adaptation or dangerous factual drift.

tests.observation: Flagged HTTP 404 dead medical citation link, stale 18-month HTTP Last-Modified timestamp, and missing FAQPage schema in live crawl.
tests.interpretation: Strong fit for periodic local website hygiene and content decay auditing.
tests.failure_modes: Desktop-bound application; does not automate content patching inside CMS.
tests.human_oversight_required: Prioritize technical vs editorial issues and implement CMS updates.
